text.description_html:
Bommer 7514, Gravity Door Pivot Hinge Box Clamp Mounted

Bommer 7514 Gravity Door Pivot Hinge, Box Clamp Mounted to Door, Surface Mounted to Jamb. Cast Steel construction pivot hinge for doors up to 30" wide and 3/4" thick with a maximum door weight of 50 lbs. The box clamp offers additional support to fragile louvered doors and is bolted through the face of the door with the included hardware.

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Their products are American made with American steel.

Specifications of the Bommer 7514:

  • Maximum Door Width: 30"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: For Louvered Doors up to 3/4" thick
  • Maximum Door Weight: 50 lbs.
  • Steel Construction
  • Surface Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Door weight closes door. No Springs
  • Non-Handed
  • Box Clamp Door Bracket
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Packaged with #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws and Thru-Bolts for Box Clamp Bracket
  • Bommer 7514 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting hardware. Enough to do one door.



** This item is Discontinued. See available Pivot Hinges.
